sentence: This project studies how environmental changes affect seaweeds, shellfish and fish that coastal communities harvest and farm.
This project builds a tool that uses improved forecasts of precipitation to help reservoir operators decide how much water to release.
This project builds a platform that uses artificial intelligence to model and predict the behavior of antibody drug formulations.
This project provides a computing system that researchers can use for simulation, artificial intelligence and data analytics.
This project designs high entropy alloy electrodes that use electricity to destroy organic micropollutants in water.
This project studies whether a stronger sense of engineering identity helps people finish their degrees.
This project builds a shared room with high-performance computing and large displays where researchers work together on data.
This project studies the drivers of changes in dryland plant species and plant communities.
This project tests how a social non-human primate solves foraging tasks and learns from others, using experiments in a wild setting.
This project works out how to make a human blood protein in a host plant that is a relative of tobacco.
This project studies how water utilities can set water rates and invest in infrastructure during drought.
This project studies data poisoning attacks on traffic state estimation and prediction and builds ways to defend against them.
This project builds methods that use deep learning to configure industrial wireless sensor-actuator networks and adapt them while running.
This project uses computational methods to design peptide chains that assemble into organized filament-like nanomaterial structures.
This project builds faster methods that solve large data analysis problems in computational imaging and artificial intelligence.
